name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
summary: The Minecraft APK is the official Android version of Minecraft (Bedrock Edition) from Mojang, the sandbox game for building, exploring and surviving. The latest version is 1.26.66.1, updated November 18, 2026, and needs Android 8.0 or newer. It costs $6.99 on Google Play, with no ads.
metaDescription: Minecraft APK download for Android: get the official Minecraft 1.26.66 from Google Play ($6.99), with install steps, kids safety and cross-play tips.

faq.q: How much is Minecraft on Android?
faq.a: Minecraft costs $6.99 on Google Play in the US, as a one-time purchase; prices vary by country. A free Minecraft Trial lets you try it first.

faq.q: Is Minecraft safe for kids to play?
faq.a: Yes. Minecraft is rated Everyone 10+ and can be played fully offline. For online play, use Microsoft Family Safety to control who children can play and chat with.
Minecraft is easier to control because it can be played offline or only with invited friends. Roblox is built around online play with strangers, so it needs more parental settings.

faq.q: Why is Minecraft Bedrock laggy on my phone?
faq.a: Lower the render distance and turn off fancy graphics in Video settings, close other apps, and free up storage. Large worlds with many redstone machines are heavier on phones.
